headline: Magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes northern Japan
content: A magnitude 6.4 earthquake struck northern Japan early Tuesday, the Japan Meteorological Agency said. Local authorities reported no immediate deaths, though several homes in Hokkaido lost power. A tsunami advisory was briefly issued and later lifted.

headline: Strong quake felt across Hokkaido, no major damage reported
content: Residents across Hokkaido described powerful shaking early Tuesday morning after a magnitude 6.4 earthquake hit the region. Train services were briefly suspended as crews inspected the tracks. Officials say there is no major structural damage so far.

headline: Big morning shake wakes up northern Japan
content: People across northern Japan woke up to a powerful earthquake early Tuesday. Several posts on social media described items falling from shelves in Sapporo. Emergency services have not reported casualties.

headline: Earthquake damages buildings in central Chile
content: An earthquake struck central Chile on Tuesday afternoon, damaging several older buildings near Santiago. Chile's emergency management office said crews were assessing the extent of the damage.

headline: Moderate quake rattles Santiago region, some buildings damaged
content: A moderate earthquake was felt across the Santiago metropolitan region on Tuesday, cracking walls in at least two older buildings. Emergency crews are inspecting affected structures near the capital.

headline: Central bank cuts benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points
content: The central bank cut its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points on Thursday, citing moderating inflation and softer job growth. It is the second cut this year.

headline: Policymakers lower interest rates as inflation cools
content: Officials reduced the benchmark interest rate by a quarter percentage point on Thursday as recent inflation figures showed further signs of easing. Markets had widely expected the move.

headline: Rate cut announced by central bank amid slowing inflation
content: The country's central bank announced a 25-basis-point rate cut on Thursday. The bank's governor said the decision reflects confidence that inflation is returning toward target.

headline: NovaTech unveils Halo 5 smartphone with new camera system
content: NovaTech introduced its Halo 5 smartphone on Wednesday, featuring a redesigned camera system, longer battery life and a lower starting price than its predecessor. Pre-orders open next week.

headline: NovaTech launches flagship Halo 5 handset
content: Technology company NovaTech launched its new flagship phone, the Halo 5, with an upgraded camera and improved battery. Reviewers say the price cut is meant to compete more directly with rival handsets.

headline: Council approves funding for new river bridge
content: The city council voted 7-2 on Wednesday to approve funding for a new pedestrian bridge across the river, with construction expected to begin next spring. Officials said the project had been delayed twice over budget concerns.

headline: Bridge project gets green light after years of delay
content: After two years of delays, the city council has approved funding for a pedestrian bridge project. Construction is expected to start in spring, according to a statement released Wednesday evening.

headline: Home side wins thriller in last-over finish
content: The home side won a tightly fought cricket match by three wickets off the final ball on Wednesday night, chasing down a target of 214. The visiting captain called it one of the closest games of the season.

headline: Last-ball six seals dramatic win for home team
content: A last-ball six sealed a dramatic three-wicket victory for the home team on Wednesday, capping a chase of 214. Fans stayed well past midnight to celebrate outside the stadium.

headline: Parliament to debate new education funding bill next week
content: Lawmakers are set to debate a new education funding bill next week that would increase spending on rural schools. The education minister said the bill has support from both major parties.

headline: Local elections set for early next year, commission confirms
content: The election commission confirmed on Wednesday that local elections will be held in early January, several weeks earlier than originally planned. Candidate registration opens next month.

headline: Farmers report driest August in over a decade
content: Farmers in the eastern growing region say this August was the driest in more than ten years, raising concerns about the upcoming harvest. Agricultural officials say water rationing may be extended into autumn.

headline: Mayor's office praises approval of downtown crossing after years of setbacks
content: The mayor's office issued a statement Thursday praising Wednesday's approval of the downtown crossing, calling it a milestone after several years of budget setbacks. The statement pointed to shorter commute times for residents on the east side once construction wraps up.

headline: Authorities inspect quake-hit buildings in Sapporo
content: Authorities in Sapporo began inspections of buildings after Tuesday's earthquake. Crews were checking older structures in the city for damage and safety concerns.
